name: Kissing Snow-White
source:
You know the tale: Snow-White, for she was the fairest maiden in the land, inflamed her stepmother's jealously. The latter, after several attempts at murdering her stepdaughter, eventually convinced her to take a bite of a poisoned apple. Since then, the young princess is doomed to eternal sleep.
Do not worry: the Prince has just got to kiss her to break the spell, as simple as you remember, and as everyone expects him to.
But... what if the prince didn't want to kiss Snow-White?

Kissing Snow-White is a rewriting taking inspiration from Walt Disney's interpretation of Brothers Grimm's Schneewittchen from the perspective of a prince who, although he loves Snow-White dearly, is unable to convey his love through physical intimacy (or to sound less hoity-toity, it's just a rewriting of the famous kissing scene we all have in mind when we think of Snow-White despite this scene not even existing in the original tale lmao). The point of the game is to convey a new point of view on social norms pressuring us into having relationships and showing affection a certain very specific way: physical intimacy, standard romantic feelings, only with a person whose gender is the one opposite to yours...

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/kissing-snow-white]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事你一定听过：白雪公主是全国最美丽的少女，因此招来了继母的嫉妒。继母几次试图杀害继女，最终哄骗她咬下了一口毒苹果。从此，年轻的公主便陷入了永远的沉睡。
别担心：王子只要亲吻她，就能解除魔咒。一切都和你记忆中的一样简单，所有人也都期待他这么做。
可是……如果王子不想亲吻白雪公主呢？

《Kissing Snow-White》受到华特·迪士尼改编的格林兄弟童话《白雪公主》启发，从王子的视角重新讲述这个故事。尽管他深爱着白雪公主，却无法通过身体上的亲密举动表达爱意。（说得不那么文绉绉一点，就是改写大家一想到白雪公主就会想到的那个著名接吻场景，虽然原版童话里根本没有这一幕，哈哈。）游戏希望提供一种新的视角，审视那些迫使我们以特定方式建立关系、表达感情的社会规范：必须有身体上的亲密接触、必须产生标准意义上的浪漫感情、对象必须是异性……

（摘自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/kissing-snow-white]itch.io[/url]）
